title: Emit stable __truth_id in synthetic.py and round-trip it through clean + ordering + reconstruct
description: Add a monotonic int64 `__truth_id` column emission to etl4/ingest/synthetic.py (both the new in-memory `generate_synthetic(n_rows, seed)` helper and the main CLI bronze write). Add a dedup tiebreaker in etl4/clean/clean.py so the lower `__truth_id` wins on `(icao24, time)` collisions when the column is present (no-op on real-data path). Ship a round-trip smoke script that drives synthetic -> inject_noise(N2) -> project_raw -> clean -> event_time_order -> all three reconstruct methods and asserts id preservation, surviving-set membership, and 1:1 correspondence with ground truth.
expected_output: etl4/ingest/synthetic.py emits __truth_id; etl4/clean/clean.py has lower-wins dedup tiebreaker; multi-agent-engineering/projects/PROJ-20261114-wi1-metrics/artifacts/t002_roundtrip.py prints ROUND-TRIP OK
acceptance_criteria: generate_synthetic(50, seed=42) returns a DataFrame with __truth_id monotonic+unique; prints EMIT OK
artifacts/t002_roundtrip.py prints ROUND-TRIP OK: 500 input, N output, N surviving ids match
pytest etl4/tests/test_pipeline.py shows 19 passed, 1 pre-existing fail; zero new regressions
clean.clean dedup tiebreaker is a no-op when __truth_id absent (manual smoke verified)
